notes: Keeps guided onboarding at the existing lightweight Brand Brain setup flow.
Reads broad public HTTP(S) Brand references including HTML, plain text and text-based PDF URLs with bounded SSRF-safe fetching.
Uses public social/profile pages such as Instagram on a best-effort basis through publicly returned metadata/content; this slice does not change Meta OAuth or provider APIs.
Allows provisional Brand Brain suggestions from owner-confirmed context when no public reference can be read, while preserving inferred-versus-confirmed state and human review.

approvals.rationale: Owner approved the simplified scope: preserve the current 2-3 step onboarding, add a universal URL reader with PDF URL capability, and keep Content Asset Library/Drive connections separate.
FR-02, FR-03 and FR-04 already authorize lightweight Brand setup, reviewable inferred Brand Brain context, and URL/website/document knowledge sources.
Owner instructed Go and proceed to URL fix, authorizing bounded implementation, tests, security verification and PR preparation. Merge/release/production remain separate gates.
Requires deterministic tests, security review and repository CI on the exact candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
Separate exact-SHA production-enable approval is required.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: A Brand owner can use an ordinary public page, social-profile URL, blog/article or text-based PDF as optional Brand evidence, and Kairo still produces reviewable provisional suggestions when public references are unavailable.
metrics: Brand Brain bootstrap failures caused only by unreadable URLs
